job.title: [Post] Maitsys - hiring
job.email_subject: Application: Developer role at Maitsys – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I saw your hiring post – I bring 5+ years of enterprise development on SAP Commerce Cloud with Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation and Shell, SAP certified. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Java, Spring Boot, microservices and OCC REST APIs
– PIM / ERP / MDM integration with international teams
– CCv2 deployment cycles, query tuning and code reviews

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring Boot & REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and query performance tuning, with proven PIM / ERP / MDM integrations and headless OCC APIs. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, supports production, performs code reviews and works techno-functionally with business stakeholders in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Maitsys places engineers with enterprise clients where they must be productive and reliable quickly. My experience with Rockwell Automation and Shell is exactly that kind of setting, and I want to bring my SAP Commerce, Java and integration depth to your next client project in Germany. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: Developer role at Maitsys
en.hook: Your hiring post looks for engineers who can deliver for demanding enterprise clients. That is my background: for more than five years I have built and extended enterprise commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud with Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation and Shell – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: Enterprise development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on Hybris 2211 following design patterns.

bullets.label: APIs
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefront, PWA frontends and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Integration
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved SAP ERP / MDM integration bottlenecks with international teams.

bullets.label: Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led query refactoring that reduced latency and performed code reviews.
